name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) Hot Grilled Pastrami Melt with Havarti on Sourdough
brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced hot pastrami with creamy, mild Havarti cheese on grilled sourdough. Rich and satisfying with bioavailable protein and gentle bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pastrami Melt on sourdough with yellow mustard or mayo; request no horseradish mustard and no sauerkraut.
watchOuts: Skip spicy horseradish mustard and fermented sauerkraut during flares
